title: ruscus gayae
intro: Ruscus gayae, commonly known as the Butcher's Broom, is a type of flowering plant in the Asparagaceae family. It is traditionally used for its medicinal properties, particularly in reducing inflammation and improving circulation, thereby alleviating symptoms associated with varicose veins, hemorrhoids, and edema. The health benefits of Ruscus gayae include its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties, which contribute to its therapeutic actions of reducing pain, swelling, and promoting wound healing. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, saponins, and ruscogenins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
